description:
Create a market research survey in LimeSurvey titled 'Smart Home Hub Feature Prioritization Study'. 

1. Login to the admin panel (admin / Admin123!).
2. Create a new survey with the title 'Smart Home Hub Feature Prioritization Study' and set the format to 'Group by group'.
3. Create 3 question groups: 'Product Concept Overview', 'Feature Prioritization', and 'Price Sensitivity'.
4. In the first group, add a Text Display question (Code: 'concept') displaying this text: 'Please review the following product concept: The SmartHome Hub Pro is a next-generation smart home controller that integrates with all major smart home ecosystems.'
5. In the second group, add a Ranking question (Code: 'featurerank') with the text: 'Please rank the following smart home hub features from most important (1) to least important (8):'. Make this question mandatory. Add exactly 8 sub-questions/items to rank: 'Voice control', 'Energy monitoring', 'Security integration', 'Lighting control', 'Climate scheduling', 'Remote access', 'Ecosystem compatibility', 'Privacy controls'.
6. In the third group, add a Numerical Input question (Code: 'maxprice') with the text: 'What is the maximum price you would be willing to pay?'. Make this mandatory.
7. Activate the survey.

metadata.real_world_goal: Product concept testing and feature prioritization
